raw_response.subject: Clarification Request: EPR Certificate Documentation
raw_response.opening_paragraph: We are writing to request clarification regarding the EPR certificates and supporting documentation submitted for your plastic waste processing activities. During our routine compliance review, we noted a few discrepancies that require your attention and clarification.

items.heading: Returned Goods Shipment PWP-02-EXT-SHP-006
items.what_we_observed: We observed that the weighbridge slip for shipment PWP-02-EXT-SHP-006 contains the remark 'माल वापस भेजा' (goods returned). This indicates that the 8.39 tonnes of material from this shipment was sent back and not processed, meaning it could not be verified from the documents provided as inbound material.
items.what_we_request: Please clarify if this shipment was indeed returned, and provide any updated documentation or alternative inbound records to confirm the status of this material.

items.heading: Certified Quantity Exceeding Verified Inbound Material
items.what_we_observed: We observed that the certified quantity of 23.86 tonnes for August 2025 exceeds the actual verified inbound material of 15.47 tonnes by 8.39 tonnes. Additionally, the total certified quantity for the FY of 136.05 tonnes exceeds the actual verified inbound material of 127.68 tonnes by 8.37 tonnes. These differences could not be verified from the documents provided.
items.what_we_request: Please provide additional supporting documentation or clarification to reconcile the certified quantities with the verified inbound material for August 2025 and the financial year.

raw_response.closing_paragraph: Please review these items and provide the requested clarifications and supporting documents within 15 days of receiving this letter. Thank you for your cooperation in ensuring compliance.
